schema_identity.column_definition: partition_id text, ck blob, value blob, PRIMARY KEY ((partition_id), ck)

integrity.registration_mode: prior matching full SHA256 audits plus current inventory/stat continuity
integrity.proof_limit: Stat continuity is not a new cryptographic read of component contents.

reuse_policy.workload_source: fresh disposable checkpoint for every workload
reuse_policy.hardlinks: Only for immutable SST components; verify full SHA256 after campaign.
reuse_policy.old_performance_numbers: Historical only; rerun baseline reads if reader, workload, settings or host changes.
reuse_policy.seed_selection: 20260909 retained from prior campaign; no outcome-based selection
reuse_policy.baseline_reload: Only if input/schema/native baseline load definition changes, or integrity fails.
